object.body:
Hello $data.requesterName,

The account $data.operationType.toLowerCase() request for $data.accountName on the $data.sourceName source failed to complete.

The request failed because of the following error:

$data.failureReason

Please contact your administrator for assistance.

Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to a requester to confirm that their account delete request has been failed.
object.name: Account Request Failed
object.subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request failed for $data.accountName
